pilot_001_population.source: thesis/results/intermediate/pilot_001/<model>/correctness.jsonl, run_id == pilot_001 (base run only; NOT the 1903 overview/repair/analysis rows)

candidate_subset.selection_rule: method-unchanged pilot_001 benchmarks (Wave-2B §34 categories A-E untouched) WHOSE GRADED COMPARISON PAYLOAD IS EXCLUSIVELY DISCRETE (int/bool/size_t scalars): for these, the verdict-relevant Wave-1/1b comparator classes K2/K3/K4/K5 are constructively unreachable (compile-time dead non-finite branches, no container in the graded path, no reachable BI condition) and K1/K7 are transport-only, so every historical verdict is method-stable by construction - no per-cell record analysis required.

excluded_from_prior_198_cell_proposal.reason: Floating-point graded payloads (vector<double>). K4: the pilot_001-era comparator was NaN-blind, so a historical 'pass' can hide non-finite candidate values without any trace in the frozen records; whether any given pass cell is affected is not determinable without re-measurement -> TRANSPORT_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED. Additionally for dense_la/00: K2 in-principle reachable (unpivoted pivot division in the oracle; NaN references structurally invisible historically). K3 (silent wrong-length pass under -DNDEBUG) shares the same no-trace problem for container payloads. Missing evidence is NOT interpreted as verdict-preserving.

transport_effect.population: the 198-cell cross-pilot proposal of the Wave-3 report (6 method-unchanged benchmarks x 11 models x 3 execution models x 1 sample)
transport_effect.counting_rule: Benchmark-level resolution: all 99 cells of the retained discrete-payload benchmarks are preserving by constructive unreachability; all 99 cells of the excluded FP-payload benchmarks are conservatively counted unresolved (individual fail-side cells there carry finite mismatch evidence and are plausibly preserving, but no per-cell claim is made). No cell shows evidence of a concrete verdict change (verdict_changed_cells = 0 means 'none demonstrated', not 'none possible' - for excluded cells the possibility is exactly why they are unresolved).
transport_effect.historical_stdout_reparse: NOT performed: historical pilot_001 stdout predates the nonce and MUST NOT be fed through the authenticated parser as a verdict comparison; the class analysis is code- and record-structure-based.

change_classes.name: authenticated nonce transport
change_classes.note: Verdict computation unchanged; only emission/authentication/parsing of the Validation/BI lines. Wave-1 tests document correct nonce emission by the trusted drivers (wave1_final_gate_report.md §3.3, §4, §12.1); Wave-1 §8.2 measured 0 effective self-declared markers across the complete pilot_001 stdout corpus, so no historical verdict depended on an unauthenticated line. Historical stdout was NOT re-parsed with the authenticated parser.

change_classes.name: non-finite reference -> BASELINE_INCOMPATIBLE
change_classes.note: Historically a NaN reference compared NaN-blind (silent pass); today the cell becomes baseline_incompatible and leaves the denominator. Historical NaN references are structurally invisible in the frozen records (Wave-1 §8.4). Reachability filter applied per benchmark: unreachable for discrete graded payloads; for dense_la/00 in-principle reachable (unpivoted division); for scan/30 and transform/55 oracle-side unreachable under the correctness-stage inputs.

change_classes.name: size-mismatch FAIL
change_classes.note: Historically assert() vanished under -DNDEBUG, allowing a silent wrong-length pass; today explicit SIZE_MISMATCH FAIL. Only applicable to container graded payloads (00/30/55); a silent historical wrong-length pass leaves no record trace, so its historical occurrence is not determinable. Not applicable to the retained scalar benchmarks.

change_classes.name: non-finite candidate FAIL
change_classes.note: Historically a NaN candidate value passed the NaN-blind tolerance predicate; today forced FAIL. A silent historical NaN pass leaves no record trace; effect on pass cells of FP benchmarks is not determinable from frozen records without re-measurement. Constructively unreachable for the retained benchmarks (int/bool/size_t scalar payloads; non-finite branches are compile-time dead code). Wave-1 §8.4 found 4 correctness records with non-finite got= values in pilot_001 (visible = already-failing cells).

change_classes.name: BASELINE_INCOMPATIBLE outranks process state
change_classes.note: Requires an authentic BI marker, which itself requires a reachable BI condition; pilot_001 predates the BI vocabulary entirely (0 markers in the frozen records). Unreachable for the retained benchmarks at the correctness stage (no BI path can fire: non-finite reference impossible for discrete payloads; search/35's TEST_SIZE==0 guard cannot fire at the correctness-stage size).

change_classes.name: repair terminal status stopped_baseline_incompatible
change_classes.note: Repair-state vocabulary change downstream of K2; outside the 396 iteration-0 cross-pilot population and measured to affect 0 pilot_001 records (0 BI stop_reasons; pilot_001 predates BI).

change_classes.name: legacy parser token-robustness fix (driver_wrapper.py)
change_classes.note: Upstream legacy parser reads the first token after the colon; identical result for all intended legacy-mode driver output (verified by real upstream regression, Wave-1 §12.3).

non_finite_reachable_by_benchmark.dense_la/00_dense_la_lu_decomp: true (oracle: unguarded pivot division, baseline.hpp:16; candidate: vector<double> payload)
non_finite_reachable_by_benchmark.graph/15_graph_edge_count: false (scalar int payload; non-finite branches compile-time dead)
non_finite_reachable_by_benchmark.scan/30_scan_prefix_sum: true (candidate: vector<double> payload; oracle-side unreachable under correctness-stage inputs)
non_finite_reachable_by_benchmark.transform/55_transform_relu: true (candidate: vector<double> payload; oracle performs no arithmetic, cannot create non-finite from finite input)

statistical_caveats: exactly 1 sample per cell - no within-cell variance estimation is possible
only 12 of 60 benchmarks were in pilot_001; only 3 of those 12 remain quantitatively comparable
the retained subset consists exclusively of scalar discrete-output benchmarks - a structural selection toward the simplest output class; results on it do not generalize to the suite
double selection bias: stratified 12-benchmark pilot selection, then method-stability filtering
PILOT_002_REUSES_PILOT_001_GENERATIONS = UNDECIDED - attribution sharpness (generation vs grading) depends on that open decision
the classification asserts FORMAL admissibility of a quantitative comparison on the named 99 cells only; it does NOT assert that pilot_001 is a strong, precise or statistically robust baseline
rationale: The Wave-3 report's 198-cell quantitative subset claim treated the suite-wide Wave-1/1b transport/comparator delta (F = WAVE1_TRANSPORT_CHANGE, kept separate from the benchmark-level A/B/C/D/E categories) as a caveat. This gate re-examined F class by class against the actual frozen records: K1/K7 are transport-only (with Wave-1 measured evidence that no pilot_001 verdict depended on unauthenticated markers); K2/K3/K4/K5 are verdict-relevant but constructively unreachable for discrete graded payloads. For the three FP-payload benchmarks the NaN-blind history makes hidden verdict changes undetectable in frozen records, so their 99 cells cannot be certified method-stable without re-measurement and are excluded. The quantitative claim is therefore narrowed to the 99 discrete-payload cells; A∪B∪C∪D∪E = 34/60 remains a benchmark-level change set only and F is never folded into it.

shared_state.hash_rule: SHA-256 over raw file bytes; no normalization, no git blob SHA. Granularity semantics and the condition canonicalization rules are documented authoritatively in check_cross_pilot_gate.py.

drivers/cpp/utilities.hpp.reason: Shared comparator core used by every candidate-subset validate(): finite/non-finite logic (mismatchIsFinite), scalar/vector comparison helpers (reportAndCompareScalar/reportAndCompare*), mismatch reporting, BI emission helper (mismatchNoteNonFiniteReference), MAX_VALIDATION_ATTEMPTS default, shared harness macros. Essentially all content is shared verdict/comparison semantics.

drivers/cpp/harness-markers.hpp.reason: Authenticated trusted marker transport: parevalEmitValidation, PAREVAL_BI_NONCE handling, marker formats for Validation/BI lines. Entire file is transport semantics.

drivers/cpp/enhanced-fill.hpp.reason: Shared enhanced input semantics: ENHANCED_FILL pattern implementations, runtime-fill mode, ENHANCED_TEST_SIZE machinery. Changes alter enhanced input generation for candidate-subset benchmarks.

drivers/cpp/models/serial-driver.cc.reason: Shared serial driver main: validation invocation flow and argv contract compiled into every serial correctness binary.

drivers/cpp/models/omp-driver.cc.reason: Shared OpenMP driver main: thread-count handling (argv[1]), fixed internal NITER, validation invocation flow.

drivers/cpp/models/mpi-driver.cc.reason: Shared MPI driver main: rank setup, root-only verdict path, validation invocation flow.

thesis/evaluation/build_config.py.reason: Declared single source of truth for compile and launch: base flags (-std=c++17 -O3), USE_* macros, compiler resolution (g++/mpicxx), -fopenmp, default launch grids (omp threads / mpi ranks 1,2,4,8). Essentially all content is measurement-condition semantics.

thesis/evaluation/run_correctness.py.reason: Contains real verdict semantics (authenticated parser, HarnessTransportError, BI classification, run/sample verdict priority, process-state/validation merge) PLUS unrelated runner code (CLI, config loading, logging, output capping, resume/orchestration). A byte diff requires inspecting whether the verdict semantics are affected.

thesis/evaluation/framework.py.reason: Contains run_command (timeout enforcement and timed_out/exit capture feeding the timeout/runtime_error verdicts) and compile-input plumbing (EvaluationContext.include_dirs) plus unrelated operational code.

thesis/evaluation/run_enhanced_tests.py.reason: Productive enhanced execution/verdict path (spec grouping, runtime-fill launches, enhanced verdicts) plus substantial runner/CLI/orchestration code.

thesis/enhanced_tests/specs.py.reason: Shared enhanced spec semantics: spec interpretation, build_benchmark_specs, spec_key identity. Changes alter what an enhanced spec means for every benchmark.

thesis/enhanced_tests/baseline_selftest..reason: Enhanced baseline gate (selftest deciding oracle evaluability before grading) plus operational code around it.

generation_condition.definition: Identical to the Wave-3 generation-condition comparison: yaml.safe_load(thesis/config/config.yaml); projection {generation_defaults, models} with models keyed by stable model id and every model field EXCEPT price_per_mtok_in/price_per_mtok_out; canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), UTF-8), SHA-256. No secrets (api_key_env is an environment-variable NAME only), no prices, no run_id, no paths, no profiles.
canonical_fields: models[id].* (all per-model fields incl. provider, provider model name, enabled flag, reasoning/thinking config, api_key_env name; excluding price_per_mtok_in/out)
generation_condition.continuity_note: This definition reproduces the Wave-3 comparison hash: the stored value equals the Wave-3 PILOT_001/PILOT_002_GENERATION_PARAMS_HASH e22ce9beb2bd9f9d85940a00585b6017eae389ad8bb933acda99f45f2d7d3281 as long as the config is unchanged.

evaluation_condition.definition: Canonical projection of the verdict-relevant correctness evaluation condition, rebuilt at check time from the productive sources: build_config.py (compilers, base flags, USE_* macros, launch grids), tools.py (DRIVER_PROBLEM_SIZE define), run_correctness.py (niter/timeout defaults, primary-compiler default), utilities.hpp (MAX_VALIDATION_ATTEMPTS default; no -D override is passed in the build), config.yaml stages.correctness_tests (niter, timeouts, launch_overrides). List order (flags, grids) preserved as produced; dict keys canonically sorted. Deliberately excluded as verdict-invariant/operational: include-directory paths, MISMATCH_REPORT_MAX (diagnostic display cap only), output/cache/report paths, run_id, logging options.
canonical_fields: ndebug_defined (currently false - NDEBUG is NOT defined in the productive correctness build)

omp.launcher: direct; argv[1]=num_threads; OMP_NUM_THREADS set; driver NITER fixed at 5

thesis/assembly/cleaning.py.reason: Pure model-output -> candidate-source transformation semantics (fence extraction, prose stripping, signature dedup incl. NO_INLINE-patched variant, include relocation, comment/string-aware brace balance). No CLI, no IO, no reporting; clean_for_assembly is a pure function of (prompt_text, raw_text). Any byte diff is highly likely methodically relevant.

thesis/assembly/assemble_sources.py.reason: Contains the generated-code.hpp construction core (patch_signature_line, assemble_content, auto-close/brace-check block, ~50 of 335 lines) PLUS substantial CLI/IO/reporting code (argparse, jsonl bookkeeping, driver-path metadata, --export-pareval-json, manifest contact, print summaries). A byte diff requires inspecting whether the candidate-source construction is affected.

condition.definition: Canonical projection of the assembly configuration that can change generated-code.hpp bytes. Verified by read-only audit: stages.assembly.auto_close_single_brace (default True; appends exactly one '}' when the assembled file's brace balance is +1 and the generation was not truncated) is the ONLY config option affecting the assembled candidate source - cleaning.clean_for_assembly reads no config; enabled/output_file_name/feedback_caps are unconsumed by the assembler or reporting-only; outputs.* keys are locations only. Canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), UTF-8), SHA-256. The repair loop reuses assemble_model() unchanged, so the same condition governs iteration assembly.

assembly_state.pipeline_note: Productive path verified read-only: generations.jsonl -> assemble_sources.assemble_model -> cleaning.clean_for_assembly (extract_code, split_at_signature, relocate_includes, brace_balance) -> assemble_content -> generated-code.hpp (+ assembly.v1 metadata records).

effective_invocation_policy.rationale: The evaluation_condition hash freezes the config/default state, but run_correctness.py accepts runtime-effective CLI overrides. A pilot run may therefore execute under a different EFFECTIVE condition while the repo-state checker still reports fresh. pilot_002 must use the frozen evaluation condition: verdict-relevant overrides are either not passed at all, or their effective values must be materialized and checked against this gate BEFORE the run (no silent mixture).

primary_compiler.expected_source: argparse default (run_correctness.py; choices g++|clang++); also frozen per manifest at first stage contact

run_timeout_seconds.expected_source: config stages.correctness_tests.run_timeout_seconds = 120 (CLI value would silently take precedence)

population_constraints.config: --config must resolve to a configuration whose generation_condition_sha256 and evaluation_condition_sha256 equal the frozen values (content-addressed; the file path itself is irrelevant)
population_constraints.model_selection: no --model-id restriction for the pilot_002 base run: all 11 enabled models of the frozen generation condition
population_constraints.run_id: --run-id/--profile must address the pilot_002 BASE run (iteration variants __*__iterN are repair populations, not the cross-pilot base population)

documented_provenance_gaps: the EFFECTIVE --run-timeout value is persisted nowhere by the runner (not in the run manifest, not in correctness records; records store timed_out/duration but never the limit in force) - therefore the preflight materialization below is the only mechanical control
the manifest freezes primary_compiler only at first stage contact; later invocations with a different --primary-compiler leave no trace and no config_drift entry
the compile argv is not stored per record

ambient environment (PATH resolution of g++/mpicxx/mpirun, OMP_*/OMPI_MCA_* variables) is copied wholesale into every compile/run child and is unrecorded - the runtime preflight environment capture is the compensating control
effective_invocation_policy.runtime_check: REQUIRED - thesis/evaluation/pilot_preflight.py --invocation <effective.json> --environment <runtime.json>; the repo-side checker validates only that the EXPECTED values remain reproducible

environment_condition.source: Frozen pilot_001 toolchain provenance thesis/results/intermediate/pilot_001/toolchain-versions.txt (copied at run time from the container-baked /opt/toolchain-versions.txt; image build 2026-07-31) plus docker/Dockerfile (FROM ubuntu:24.04). The pilot_001 run_manifest.json itself carries primary_compiler='g++' but primary_compiler_version=null and toolchain_versions=null because the manifest was frozen host-side by the generation stage - the side file is the authoritative toolchain record.
environment_condition.container_pinning_classification: TAG_ONLY - docker/Dockerfile pins no digest (FROM ubuntu:24.04), apt packages float at build time, and no image digest/ID is recorded in any repository provenance artifact. TAG_ONLY is NOT digest-pinned reproducibility; this is stated honestly rather than claiming a pinned image.
runtime_requirements: before pilot_002, capture inside the execution container: first line of `g++ --version`, first line of `mpirun --version`, and the concrete docker image ID or repo digest of the pareval-thesis image actually used
compare via thesis/evaluation/pilot_preflight.py; a missing captured value is UNRESOLVED and blocks the pilot (missing runtime provenance is never a match)
persist the captured image ID/digest as run provenance (upgrades the classification toward IMAGE_ID_RECORDED for that run)

validity.staleness_check: recompute_candidate_subset_state_hashes + recompute_shared_state_file_hashes + recompute_generation_condition_hash + recompute_evaluation_condition_hash + recompute_assembly_state_hashes + recompute_assembly_condition_hash + verify_expected_invocation_values + verify_environment_provenance
validity.checker: thesis/evaluation/check_cross_pilot_gate.py (authoritative hash rules in its docstring; exit 0 fresh / 1 stale / 2 unresolved)
validity.scope: candidate_subset.benchmarks + shared_state (shared measurement dependencies, generation condition, evaluation condition) + assembly_state + effective_invocation_policy + environment_condition (repo-side; runtime values via pilot_preflight)
validity.note: stale=false is only a cached status as of state_commit; the authoritative staleness signal is recomputation of the stored fingerprints under the rules in the checker.

matrix.notes: benchmark-local sources plus the shared driver mains compiled into every binary

covered_by: shared_state.files (utilities.hpp, harness-markers.hpp, run_correctness.py, framework.py, build_config.py, model drivers)
matrix.notes: run_correctness.py and framework.py are coarse: a diff there triggers STALE but requires inspecting semantic relevance
benchmark-local spec projection plus the shared enhanced harness/runner path

covers the response-relevant condition (system prompt, generation params, model identities/reasoning config); the generation/assembly PIPELINE CODE (provider adapters, extraction/cleaning) is a documented scope boundary outside this category's definition

covers launch grids, compilers/flags, NDEBUG state, DRIVER_PROBLEM_SIZE, niter, MAX_VALIDATION_ATTEMPTS, build/run timeouts; environment-level state (container image, compiler binary versions) is a documented scope boundary - it is not addressable as a repo file hash
cleaning is a pure function of (prompt_text, raw_text); the single content-affecting config option is captured; the repair loop reuses the same assembly path

covered_by: repo-side checker (expected values reproducible from defaults/config)
matrix.notes: repo-side coverage of the EXPECTED values is complete, but the ACTUAL invocation is only checkable at runtime (EFFECTIVE_INVOCATION_RUNTIME_CHECK = REQUIRED); the runner persists no effective --run-timeout and ambient-environment overrides (PATH, OMP_*/OMPI_MCA_*) are unrecorded - both documented gaps are compensated only by the mandatory preflight

covered_by: pilot_preflight runtime capture (compiler/MPI versions, image ID/digest)
matrix.notes: container is TAG_ONLY pinned (no digest recorded anywhere); toolchain-versions.txt reflects image BUILD time, not run time; a rebuilt image can drift silently - therefore ENVIRONMENT_RUNTIME_CHECK = REQUIRED and missing runtime provenance blocks the pilot

known_scope_boundaries: generation pipeline CODE (provider adapters, request/response handling in thesis/generation/**) remains outside the fingerprinted categories; the assembly/cleaning path (model response -> candidate source) is now fingerprinted under assembly_semantics

toolchain/environment BINARIES are not repo files: expected values are frozen from recorded pilot_001 provenance under environment_condition, the container is honestly classified TAG_ONLY, and a runtime preflight capturing the actual image ID/digest and tool versions is mandatory before pilot_002

pilot_preflight.note: This preflight authorizes only the cross-pilot condition; the separately documented open blockers before pilot_002 (open semantic decisions with disclosure interlocks, reuse decision, publication decision, enhanced pattern wave, tool-state gates) remain.
